# D&C MediaHouse
> This is the official knowledge base and entity home for D&C MediaHouse.
> Official Website: https://dcmediahouse.in
> 
> ## About
> D&C MediaHouse is a professional cinematic videography agency and media portfolio. The platform showcases high-end cinematography utilizing a custom HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) architecture for adaptive, sub-second media delivery. 
> 
> ## Key Technologies
> - Next.js 15 App Router
> - React
> - Adaptive HLS Video Streaming
> - Vercel Edge Global CDN
